title: Drunk [V10]
description: Track 14 on a tracklist posted by Ty Dolla $ign. Was played briefly at the VULTURES Miami rave, however it was not played on the live stream due to the stream having connection problems while the song was playing. This version lacks Ye vocals, with SHDØW previously stating that he was sent the original song to produce a new beat over. It's likely Ye did record for it however, as he is confirmed to have recorded to every song on this tracklist except for this one. Filename shared by VEYIS on Instagram, saying it was one of his favorite songs he produced. Bad Bunny's vocals originate from Spiff TV's unreleased song "So Drunk". Kodak had confirmed a Bad Bunny collaboration in a 2022 interview, which was most likely this song before it was taken for VULTURES. Another snippet was previewed by SHDØW May 29th, 2024.

title: POLAR FLEECE ZIP UP (H14A)
description:
Background: The YZY GAP Fleece Zip Up was initially planned for release in the Fall of 2022 as a part of the Holiday 2022 collection. Due to controversies surrounding Ye at the time, the collection was cancelled and the Polar Fleece Zip Up first appeared in 2024 through 3rd party sellers, which Gap would liquidate to.  

It features a nicer fleece as opposed to the other Fleece Hoodie apart of the Holiday 2022 collection.

The Polar Fleece Zip Up did not release on yeezy.com.
